interpretation: 1 means Gold, 2 means Silver, and 3 means Bronze. These numbers identify badge levels.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the required source information is unavailable.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: TRUE or FALSE. TRUE means the condition is present; FALSE means it is absent. Empty means the source value is unavailable.
definition: Whether the badge was earned for activity associated with a particular topic tag.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Badges.TagBased; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: TRUE means the condition is present and FALSE means it is absent; FALSE is a valid recorded result.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the source is unavailable. FALSE is a valid recorded result.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Integer score or score difference. Positive, zero, and negative values retain their Stack Exchange score meaning. Empty means the score is unavailable.
definition: The number of positive community votes received by a comment.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Comments.Score; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: 0 means no positive comment votes are recorded; larger values mean more users endorsed the comment.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the score is unavailable. A value of 0 is a valid recorded score.
notes: Available in the current XML inputs and retained outside the question-level output until a separate table or explicit aggregation is defined.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer count. 0 means that the counted quantity is absent. Empty means the source needed for counting is unavailable.
definition: The number of users who marked the question as a favorite or saved item in data versions that provide this field.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Posts.FavoriteCount; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Zero means no recorded favorites; larger values indicate more recorded favorites.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means this source field is unavailable. A value of 0 means no favorites were recorded.
notes: Source availability and meaning require verification for the selected Stack Exchange dump.

unit_or_values: 1 = Question; 2 = Answer. These are categorical codes; equality comparison applies. Empty means the code is unavailable.
definition: A category code telling whether a post is a question or an answer.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Posts.PostTypeId; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: 1 means Question and 2 means Answer. The codes identify post categories.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the related record or relationship is unavailable.
notes: Available in the current XML inputs and retained outside the question-level output until a separate table or explicit aggregation is defined.

unit_or_values: net votes
definition: The question's voting result at the dump snapshot: up-votes increase the value and down-votes decrease it.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates the net voting score and stores it in Posts.Score; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Positive values show more up-votes than down-votes, zero shows a balanced or limited voting result, and negative values show more down-votes.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when the source score is unavailable.
notes: Produced by the current builder and mapped to the current output field.

unit_or_values: views
definition: The number of times Stack Exchange recorded the question page as viewed by the dump snapshot.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the view total in Posts.ViewCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Higher values show greater recorded exposure. Question age and site traffic also influence this count.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row omits the view count.
notes: Produced by the current builder and mapped to the current output field.

unit_or_values: answers
definition: The number of answers shown in the count stored by Stack Exchange on the question row.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the answer total in Posts.AnswerCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Zero denotes no answer in the platform-maintained count. Comparison with available_answer_count identifies source-row differences.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source count is unavailable.
notes: Dictionary v5 name mapped to the canonical field stackexchange_answer_count: recorded_answer_count.

unit_or_values: comments
definition: The number of comments shown in the count stored by Stack Exchange on the question row.
calculation: Stack Exchange maintains the question-comment total in Posts.CommentCount; the value is copied from the selected question row.
interpretation: Zero denotes no question comment in the platform-maintained count. Comparison with available_question_comment_count identifies source-row differences.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source count is unavailable.
notes: Dictionary v5 name mapped to the canonical field stackexchange_comment_count: recorded_comment_count.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer count. 0 means that the counted quantity is absent. Empty means the source needed for counting is unavailable.
definition: The number of questions currently associated with the tag according to Stack Exchange.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Tags.Count; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Zero means no questions carrying the tag; larger values indicate more questions carrying the tag.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the source needed to produce the count is unavailable. A value of 0 is a valid observed count.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer count. 0 means that the counted quantity is absent. Empty means the source needed for counting is unavailable.
definition: The total number of down-votes the user has cast.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Users.DownVotes; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Zero means no down-votes cast by the user; larger values indicate more down-votes cast by the user.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the source needed to produce the count is unavailable. A value of 0 is a valid observed count.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer reputation points maintained by Stack Exchange. Larger values indicate more accumulated reputation. Empty means the platform value is unavailable.
definition: The user's current reputation-point total on the Stack Exchange site.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Users.Reputation; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Larger values indicate more reputation accumulated on the selected Stack Exchange site. Valid comparisons use the same site and extraction date because reputation changes over time.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the required source information is unavailable.
evidence_or_reference: SOQDE 2018; Mondal et al. 2021; Raida et al. 2024
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer count. 0 means that the counted quantity is absent. Empty means the source needed for counting is unavailable.
definition: The total number of up-votes the user has cast.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Users.UpVotes; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Zero means no up-votes cast by the user; larger values indicate more up-votes cast by the user.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the source needed to produce the count is unavailable. A value of 0 is a valid observed count.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Non-negative integer count. 0 means that the counted quantity is absent. Empty means the source needed for counting is unavailable.
definition: The number of times the user's profile page has been viewed according to Stack Exchange.
calculation: Stack Exchange calculates and maintains the value in Users.Views; the catalogue records the maintained source value.
interpretation: Zero means no recorded profile views; larger values indicate more recorded profile views.
empty_value_meaning: An empty value means the source needed to produce the count is unavailable. A value of 0 is a valid observed count.
notes: The required additional dump table is outside the current production inputs.

unit_or_values: Stack Exchange host name
definition: The Stack Exchange site from which the question was extracted.
calculation: The plain host supplied through --site is copied to every selected question row.
interpretation: The value distinguishes communities because each Stack Exchange site has its own topics, accounts, and moderation practices.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: YYYY-MM-DD
definition: The date represented by the downloaded Stack Exchange dump.
calculation: The date supplied through --dump-date is copied to every selected question row.
interpretation: Every snapshot-based score, view, count, and text field is observed by this date, which defines the end of the observation period.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: URL
definition: The direct web address of the original question.
calculation: The site host and question_id are inserted into the address pattern https://{site}/questions/{question_id}.
interpretation: The address identifies the public question page when that page remains available online.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: UTC datetime
definition: The most recent question edit time recorded in the dump.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.LastEditDate on the selected question row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: Comparison with the creation time identifies whether an edit occurred and gives the most recent recorded edit time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no recorded edit.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: semicolon-separated tags
definition: The question tags in a simple list that is easy to read and split.
calculation: Each name between angle brackets is extracted, and the names are joined with semicolons.
interpretation: Semicolon separation yields the individual topic names. One question can carry several tags.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no source tags.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: licence name
definition: The content licence recorded for the question row.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.ContentLicense on the selected question row.
interpretation: The licence, question URL, and author information govern sharing and reuse of question content.
empty_value_meaning: Empty for an older source row that omits the licence field.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: display name
definition: The source display name stored directly on the post, mainly for authors without an available user identifier.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the selected question row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: The source name supports attribution when Stack Exchange stores a name directly on the post.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row provides no direct display name.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: links
definition: The number of hyperlinks in the question body.
calculation: The value equals the number of HTML a elements containing an href attribute.
interpretation: Zero means the question contains no hyperlink. Larger values indicate greater reliance on linked context.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no hyperlink is present.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: images
definition: The number of images embedded in the question body.
calculation: The value equals the number of HTML img elements.
interpretation: Zero means the question contains no embedded image. Larger values indicate more visual material.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no image is present.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

source: Posts answer rows with ParentId = question_id
unit_or_values: available answer rows
definition: The number of answer rows that are actually available in Posts.xml for the question.
calculation: The value equals the number of matching PostTypeId = 2 rows in the dump.
interpretation: Zero means no answer row is available in Posts.xml. Larger values mean more human responses are available for analysis.
empty_value_meaning: Zero when no answer row is available.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: TRUE or FALSE
definition: Whether at least one answer row is available for the question in the dump.
calculation: The value is TRUE when available_answer_count is greater than zero and FALSE when it equals zero.
interpretation: TRUE means at least one answer row is available; FALSE means the available answer count is zero.
empty_value_meaning: Never empty in a valid output.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: answer identifier
definition: The identifier of the earliest available answer by creation time.
calculation: Available answers are ordered by CreationDate and numeric Id; the first row supplies the value.
interpretation: The identifier locates the earliest available answer selected by timestamp and numeric ID.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no answer row is available.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: TRUE or FALSE
definition: Whether the answer named by accepted_answer_id is present in Posts.xml.
calculation: The value is TRUE when the available answers contain a row whose Posts.Id equals accepted_answer_id.
interpretation: TRUE means the accepted-answer row is present and its content can be analyzed; FALSE means the row is absent or the question has no accepted-answer identifier.
empty_value_meaning: FALSE when no accepted answer is recorded or its row is unavailable.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: web address
definition: The direct web address of the answer currently identified as accepted.
calculation: The address is constructed as https://{site}/a/{accepted_answer_id}.
interpretation: The address identifies the currently accepted answer and supports attribution when that page remains available online.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the question has no accepted answer identifier.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

source: Posts.OwnerUserId on the available accepted-answer row
unit_or_values: user identifier
definition: The Stack Exchange user identifier of the accepted-answer author when the account is available in the dump.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerUserId on the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: The identifier supports accepted-answer author attribution and source joins when the account is available.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row or its author account is unavailable.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

source: Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the available accepted-answer row
unit_or_values: display name
definition: The author display name stored directly on the accepted-answer row.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.OwnerDisplayName on the available accepted-answer row when that attribute is present.
interpretation: The source name supports accepted-answer attribution when Stack Exchange stores it directly on the answer row.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the source row provides no direct display name.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

source: Posts.ContentLicense on the available accepted-answer row
unit_or_values: licence name
definition: The content licence recorded for the accepted answer.
calculation: The value is copied from Posts.ContentLicense on the available accepted-answer row.
interpretation: The licence, accepted-answer URL, and author information govern sharing and reuse of answer content.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when the accepted-answer row is unavailable or the older source row has no licence field.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

source: Votes.CreationDate where PostId = accepted_answer_id and VoteTypeId = 1
unit_or_values: YYYY-MM-DD
definition: The first recorded day on which the currently accepted answer received an acceptance vote.
calculation: The earliest matching VoteTypeId = 1 date supplies the value. Public-dump vote timestamps have day-level precision.
interpretation: This day records the acceptance action for the currently accepted answer. Public vote timestamps provide calendar-day precision.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when no matching acceptance vote is available.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: calendar days
definition: The number of calendar days from question posting to the first recorded acceptance day for the currently accepted answer.
calculation: The calendar date of question_creation_datetime is subtracted from acceptance_date.
interpretation: Zero means acceptance occurred on the question posting day. Larger values mean more calendar days passed before the recorded acceptance action.
empty_value_meaning: Empty when acceptance_date is unavailable or the interval is invalid.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.

unit_or_values: calendar days
definition: The number of calendar days between question posting and the dump snapshot.
calculation: The calendar date of question_creation_datetime is subtracted from dump_snapshot_date.
interpretation: Larger values provide more time for accumulated answers, comments, votes, and views. The field controls unequal follow-up time.
empty_value_meaning: Empty only when either date is invalid.
notes: Added from the verified production schema during Dictionary v5 synthesis.
